query: INSERT INTO social_media_platform_schedule (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, platform, auto_post, posts_per_week, max_posts_per_day, post_times, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2, FALSE, $3, $4, $5::text::jsonb, 'auto_default' FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id, platform) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
